# RETRO: PR #13031 (team 3)

## What worked
- Cross-examination was decisive. The reviewers disagreed on `monospace` and `omarchy font set`. One neutral follow-up that named the mechanism (the default conf.d rules before 50-*) led Sol to rerun against Arch's packaged default chain and withdraw its claim. Without the second reviewer, a false P2 could have been published.
- Opus caught its own wrong source-only hypothesis with an FC_DEBUG trace.

## Avoidable friction / process deviations
- Coordinator: `pi_job.py wait` prints the job's `latest_text`, which exposed Sol's one-line closing summary before the Opus final was saved. It was not shared with Opus. Suggestion: have `wait` omit `latest_text` by default, or have coordinators redirect its output.
- Opus: one host-side `python3 -c` on a downloaded 404 JSON body, outside review.py. One `ls -la` resolved owner names.
- Opus: the sandbox had no node, so it fetched the official Node v24.21.0 binary (sha256 checked, GPG not checked).
- Sol: its first full-chain fixture failed at setup (relative vs absolute include). The failure was preserved and excluded.
- Sol's initial fixture modelled only two fontconfig rules. Lesson for future briefs: when a fontconfig or config-chain behavior is material, require fixtures to use the distribution's packaged default rule set in installation order, not a reduced chain.

## Tooling ideas
- review.py fixtures could offer a node runtime option, so reviewers need not fetch binaries.
- A reusable "Arch packaged fontconfig default chain" fixture would help future font PRs.

## Carry forward
- Omadev nested sessions would settle live-rebinding claims for shell.toml tokens. None were reserved here.

## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Verified:** No functional issue found in the tested scope. The new `[notifications] font-family` token behaves as described, and the default rendering is unchanged.

| Case | Result at head `72896ff` |
|---|---|
| Token absent, empty, or only the commented template line | `Liberation Sans` (same as before) |
| Set in a theme `shell.toml` | Theme value used for summary and body |
| Set in `~/.config/omarchy/shell.toml` | User value wins over the theme, in either load order, and survives a theme switch |
| User file removed | Falls back to the theme value, then the default |
| `font-family = "monospace"` after `omarchy font set "<family>"` | Resolves to the chosen family first (fontconfig 2.18.3, Arch's default `conf.d` chain plus `50-omarchy.conf` and the exact rule `omarchy font set` writes) |

Scope stays on summary and body: the glyph slot still uses the bar font and the close glyph keeps its default. Glyph fallback for Nerd Font and emoji characters remains available with any chosen family, because Qt's fallback list comes from the full fontconfig sort. The PR's test passes on head (138 ok), and the head test fails on the base sources at the first new assertion, as expected.

The `monospace` result depends on earlier stock fontconfig rules (`48-guessfamily.conf`, `49-sansserif.conf`), which add weak `monospace` entries. `50-omarchy.conf` replaces only the first, strong entry, so the rule `omarchy font set` writes still matches:

```text
request "monospace"
  10-49 stock rules   -> monospace(strong), monospace(weak), monospace(weak)
  50-omarchy.conf     -> JetBrainsMono Nerd Font(strong), monospace(weak), ...
  50-user.conf        -> <chosen family>(strong), JetBrainsMono Nerd Font(strong), ...
```

**Documentation note:** `docs/omarchy-shell.md` (Typography, "themes don't set it") and the `fontFamily` comment in `shell/Commons/Style.qml` ("the family stays system-wide") now conflict with the new `docs/theming.md` text, which says the notification family can be set in a theme. **Suggested change:** add a one-line notification exception to both places. Whether the token belongs in `Color` (documented as palette and surface roles) or with typography in `Style` is a maintainer choice.

**Optional test improvement:** the three new assertions match source text, and some regressions still pass them. In isolated mutation runs, the test still passed when the summary bound a misspelled property sharing the prefix (`Color.notifications.fontFamilyTypo`), and when the Color line was changed to `root.pick(...) && "Liberation Sans"`, which forces the default. Anchoring the patterns (for example `fontFamily\b` in the count and an end-of-line anchor on the `Color.qml` line) would catch both.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source review of the pinned head and base, plus isolated command-only runs: the PR's notification test on head and base, mutation variants of the new assertions, the `Color.qml` parse, merge and `pick` functions evaluated under Node against default, theme, user and theme-switch cases, and fontconfig 2.18.3 substitution with Arch's packaged default rules. Qt 6.11.2 font-resolution source was read, not executed. No QML or GUI session was run, so live rebinding of notifications already on screen is supported by source only. `./test/all` was not run.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, independent Opus 5.5 Xhigh and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, with a targeted follow-up on fontconfig rule order, and an Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.

**Opt out:** To stop receiving these reviews, reply to this comment saying so.
